# Command reference

Every `gskill` command and its flags, generated from the CLI grammar.

## Global flags

These apply to every command.

| Flag | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | Path to a config file. |
| `--dir` | string | Run as if gskill started in this directory. |
| `--dry-run` | bool | Report actions without applying them. |
| `--json` | bool | Emit machine-readable JSON on stdout. |
| `--no-cache` | bool | Bypass the content cache. |
| `--no-interactive` | bool | Disable prompts and colored output. |
| `--offline` | bool | Operate without network access. |
| `--quiet` | bool | Suppress diagnostics on stderr. |
| `--verbose` | bool | Enable verbose diagnostics. |
| `--yes` | bool | Assume yes for confirmation prompts. |


## `add`

Add and install a new skill (auto-initializes the project if needed).

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | yes | Skill source: git shorthand, URL, or local path. |

| Flag | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--agent` | []string | Target agent ID (repeatable). Additive: adds to, never replaces, a skill's already-installed agents. To replace a skill's agent set outright, use 'gskill install --agent'. |
| `--all` | bool | Select every valid discovered skill. |
| `--auto` | bool | Prefer a symlink, fall back to a copy (default). |
| `--commit` | string | Explicit commit SHA to pin. |
| `--copy` | bool | Copy instead of linking. |
| `--exact` | bool | Pin to the exact resolved version. |
| `--exclude` | []string | Skip skills whose in-repo path matches this glob (repeatable). |
| `--force` | bool | Overwrite an existing declaration and re-resolve. |
| `--global` | bool | Install into the user-global location. |
| `--include` | []string | Only discover skills whose in-repo path matches this glob (repeatable). |
| `--list` | bool | List discovered skills without installing. |
| `--max-depth` | int | Maximum recursive scan depth (0 = unbounded). |
| `--path` | string | In-repo path disambiguator for a duplicated --skill. |
| `--project` | bool | Install into the project (default). |
| `--ref` | string | Branch or tag to track. |
| `--skill` | []string | Select a discovered skill by name (repeatable; '*' selects all; name@path disambiguates). |
| `--symlink` | bool | Symlink, never copy. |
| `--version` | string | Semver constraint (e.g. ^2.0.0). |

## `install`

Realize what skills.toml declares (resolve changes, install, record the lockfile). Never edits skills.toml.

| Flag | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--agent` | []string | Target agent(s); repeatable or comma-separated. This is the exact desired set: it replaces (not merges with) each skill's currently recorded agents — list every agent you want kept, not just the one being added. |
| `--copy` | bool | Copy instead of symlinking (deprecated alias for --install-mode copy). |
| `--force` | bool | Accept changed upstream content: reinstall and rewrite the recorded computedHash. |
| `--frozen-lockfile` | bool | Restore exactly from the lockfile; never modify it. |
| `--install-mode` | string | How skills are placed into agent directories. |
| `--no-init` | bool | Never auto-initialize the project; fail instead. |
| `--prune` | bool | Remove managed installs whose lock entries are gone. |


## `list`

List installed skills, their status, and per-agent health.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `--fail-on-drift` | bool | Exit non-zero (7) if any drift is detected. |


## `project diff`

Show lock/disk differences.


## `project repair`

## `project sync`

Reconcile disk to the lock's declared state (--prune removes managed orphans).

| Flag | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--prune` | bool | Remove managed agent targets and active entries the lock no longer declares. |


## `project verify`

| `--owner` | string | Search a GitHub user/org's repositories. |
| `--source` | string | Search within one source. |


## `update`

Re-resolve declared skills to the newest revision their skills.toml constraint allows. Never edits skills.toml.

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `skills` | no | Skills to update (default: all with available updates). |

| Flag | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` | bool | With --list: also report up-to-date, pinned, and local skills. |
| `--list` | bool | List available updates without applying them. |


## `upgrade`

Move a skill's declared version in skills.toml, then resolve, lock, install, and verify it.

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `skill` | no | Skills to upgrade. With exactly one skill, a second argument is the target version (same as --to). |

| Flag | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` | bool | Without skill names and outside a terminal: upgrade every upgradable skill. |
| `--latest` | bool | Move to the newest stable release beyond the current declaration (the default). |
| `--to` | string | Exact target version or tag; must exist as a release of the skill's source. |


## `version`

Print the gskill version.
